name: Lobster
description: Typed workflow tool with resumable approvals.

managedWorkflows.description: Host-owned named Lobster workflows exposed through the narrow managed TaskFlow bridge.

pipeline.description: Lobster pipeline string owned by host configuration.

goal.description: TaskFlow goal for runs of this workflow.

controllerId.description: TaskFlow controller id. Defaults to lobster/<workflowId>.

allowSandboxed.description: Allow sandboxed agent sessions to run this named workflow.

approvalMode.description: Use taskflow to leave Lobster approvals in waitJson, or plugin-inline to request plugin approval and resume in the same tool call.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: Inline plugin approval timeout. Defaults to 120000ms and is capped at 600000ms.

requireIdempotency.description: Require idempotencyKey on run calls. Defaults to true.
